assertions.text: Output contains a @TableTest annotation
assertions.evidence: Found @TableTest annotation

assertions.text: Email validation and name-required error scenarios are present — at least one row for invalid email and one for missing name.
assertions.evidence: Missing name (null) | ... | false | Name is required ... Invalid email, missing @ | ... | false | Invalid email format

assertions.text: Dietary requirements and/or accessibility needs use blank cells (null) when not provided
assertions.evidence: Valid registration | Alice | alice@example.com | | | true |

assertions.text: irrelevant inputs use value sets or representative values — not blanks
assertions.evidence: Group discount applies | after cutoff | {5, 20} | 15.00 | 85.00 ... pricing table omits dietary/accessibility columns

assertions.text: Table has a scenario/description column as the leftmost column
assertions.evidence: First column(s): "Scenario", "Scenario"

assertions.text: At least one output column name ends with '?' (e.g. 'Result?', 'Price?')
assertions.evidence: Question-mark columns: Accepted?, Error Message?, Discount?, Price?

assertions.text: Column names use domain/business language
assertions.evidence: Scenario | Name | Email | Dietary Requirements | Accessibility Needs | Accepted? | Error Message?

assertions.text: Scenario names name the variation, not the result
assertions.evidence: No discount applies | after cutoff | 1 | 0.00 | 100.00 — echoes the Discount? cell exactly as the assertion's own failing example.

assertions.text: Test method body contains no if or switch statements
assertions.evidence: 2 method(s) checked — no if/switch/ternary

assertions.text: Annotations appear in order: @DisplayName (if present), @Description (if present), @TableTest — not any other order.
assertions.evidence: Annotations in correct order: @DisplayName, @Description, @TableTest

assertions.text: Test method has either a @DisplayName annotation or a method name that reads as a clear, descriptive title when converted from camelCase/snake_case.
assertions.evidence: 2 @TableTest method name(s) read as descriptive titles (no @DisplayName needed)

assertions.text: If @Description is present and the text is longer than a single short line, it uses a text block (triple-quoted string """), not string concatenation with +. Passes if @Description is absent.
assertions.evidence: @Description uses text block or is short single-line

assertions.text: Multiple tables each addressing a distinct concern
assertions.evidence: validatesRegistration(...) and calculatesPricingAndDiscount(...) are separate @TableTest methods

assertions.text: Each @TableTest has only the rows needed
assertions.evidence: Missing name (null)/(empty)/(blank) and four invalid-email variants (missing @, local part, domain, TLD) re-cover the same rule multiple times.

assertions.text: Input validation and pricing/discount calculation are in separate @TableTest methods
assertions.evidence: void validatesRegistration(...) { ... } and void calculatesPricingAndDiscount(...) { ... }

assertions.text: Validation @TableTest includes Dietary Requirements and Accessibility Needs columns with null and non-null rows
assertions.evidence: Valid with optional fields | Bob | bob@example.com | Vegetarian | Wheelchair access | true

assertions.text: Registration date uses descriptive values with a @TypeConverter
assertions.evidence: case "before cutoff" -> EARLY_BIRD_CUTOFF.minusDays(1); case "on cutoff" -> EARLY_BIRD_CUTOFF; case "after cutoff" -> EARLY_BIRD_CUTOFF.plusDays(1);

assertions.text: Cutoff appears as separate column if dates are literal; passes automatically if descriptive dates used.
assertions.evidence: Registration Date column uses 'before cutoff', 'on cutoff', 'after cutoff' via @TypeConverter, not literal dates.

assertions.text: @Description does not restate info visible in columns or derivable from table structure.
assertions.evidence: "Base price is £100. Early-bird registrations (before 2025-03-01) get 20% off; groups of 5 or more get 15% off..." states constants/thresholds not shown as columns.

assertions.text: Discount? column preferred; if Price? used instead, Base price and Price? must both be present.
assertions.evidence: "Scenario | Registration Date | Group Size | Discount? | Price?" — Discount? is present as the primary output alongside Price?.

assertions.text: Each @TableTest method applies one uniform assertion pattern to every row — not different assertions per scenario. Several unconditional assertions checking distinct observable outputs of one result (e.g. success, message, resulting cart) count as one uniform pattern; the anti-pattern is branching on the row (if/switch/ternary/try-catch) to choose what is asserted.
assertions.evidence: 2 method(s) apply one uniform assertion pattern to all rows

assertions.text: Optional-fields table includes an expectation/output column.
assertions.evidence: "Scenario | Name | Email | Dietary Requirements | Accessibility Needs | Accepted? | Error Message?"

assertions.text: Scenario names and @Description do not restate values the table already shows.
assertions.evidence: Scenario names like "Just under group threshold", "Both apply, early-bird wins" contain no literal cell values duplicated from input columns.

assertions.text: The build file (build.gradle) includes org.tabletest:tabletest-junit as a test dependency
assertions.evidence: Build file contains tabletest-junit

assertions.text: Cell values make the rule falsifiable, not merely distinguishable.
assertions.evidence: Discount? values vary: "0.00", "20.00", "0.00", "0.00", "15.00", "20.00" — not constant nor copies of input columns.

assertions.text: A reader can state the rule from the table alone, without the test method body.
assertions.evidence: "Base price is £100. Early-bird registrations (before 2025-03-01) get 20% off; groups of 5 or more get 15% off..." gives all needed constants in the @Description.

assertions.text: The generated test code compiles successfully against the project scaffolding
assertions.evidence: Compilation succeeded

assertions.text: Rows must cover any domain quantified by title/description.
assertions.evidence: "dietaryRequirements and accessibilityNeeds are optional and do not affect acceptance" is covered by rows with blank and with values (Vegetarian, Wheelchair access).
